inputs.name: specifications
inputs.description: Feature specs, user stories, acceptance criteria

outputs.name: compliance-report
outputs.description: Passed/failed checks per principle, required actions

outputs.name: debt-register-update
outputs.description: Technical debt entries with severity ratings

validation_rules: Veto authority: any violation of SOLID, Clean Architecture, DDD, or ADRs blocks the proposal
Every check must reference a specific rule or principle
Violations must include severity, location, and remediation recommendation
ADR conflicts must be resolved before proposal can proceed
Serial execution before Code Reviewer — Architecture Guardian pass required
Technical debt entries must include severity (low/medium/high/critical) and remediation path
